description: The agent's own task list, which the harness mirrors into the UI as the run's progress view (see src/agent/todos.ts). TodoWrite is the older CLI's shape; TaskCreate/TaskUpdate/TaskGet/TaskList are what current builds emit, and TaskUpdate in particular is the only signal that an item moved to in_progress. None of them mutate anything outside the agent's own state. Allowed unconditionally: gating them behind a human approval would stall the run on the tools whose entire purpose is telling the human what's happening. Routed through the filter engine (rather than a bare `allowedTools` entry) so the decision still lands in tool_events like every other tool call.
